_reask_note: both values come from the environment (WX_REASK_BASE_URL, WX_REASK_API_KEY); leave them empty here
_desk_note: the desk's own figures, shown only where the exchange is not quoting and always labelled as estimates: pool figures while a storm has no listed pool (lhl_url), and wind ladders for a station-day with no open MG board (mg_url, or mg_key to read the file from this site's own storage instead of fetching it). Values come from the environment (WX_DESK_LHL_URL, WX_DESK_MG_URL, WX_DESK_MG_KEY, WX_DESK_API_KEY) and each lane is off when its url and key are both empty. Anything written under mg_key is served by the CDN and is therefore public. The owner switched the MG lane off on 3 November 2026 (mg_publish false), so no desk figure reaches a page.

season_forecast.source: Colorado State University Tropical Meteorology Project
season_forecast.label: CSU, 5 Aug 2026

_season_forecast_note: A seasonal hurricane forecast is not a government product, so this is an owner's choice and is attributed wherever it is drawn. Empty values fall back to the climatological pace alone. Update the numbers and the label together when CSU revises.
_exchange_fee_note: Dollars per contract each side pays at execution, used only to state payout multiples net of fees. The exchange's published fee schedule is $0.01 per contract, charged per side, which the owner confirmed with the exchange on 6 October 2026, so the multiple is 1/(price + 0.01). It replaces the half cent a side this site used before 3 November 2026. Every multiple names the fee it used.

expected_listings._note: Listings the owner has said the exchange will carry but which it has not listed yet. Shown on the matching basin view as pending, never with a price. Delete an entry once the exchange lists it: the Hawaii landfall contract was listed on 2026-09-03 and its entry was removed then. Lowell's (EP, wind gust contracts and a highest-wind pool at Honolulu, Hilo, Kahului and Kapa'a) was removed on 2026-10-10, the storm no longer being in NHC's roster.

gdp_contract._note: The world GDP per person contract on climate-gdp.html (owner, 2026-11-02). It is proposed to list in mid-January 2027. Until then the page draws the proposed strikes from its model file, hatched, with no price. Once the exchange lists it, put its product id here and add it to config/contracts.json (scripts/build_contracts.py), so the catalogue jobs carry its terms and quotes. The page then draws the exchange's prices, each opening the contract on IBKR.
